verdicts.label: NOT_ENOUGH_EVIDENCE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: While crocodiles have been repeatedly sighted in Kukkarahalli Lake, with reports in December 2024, January 2026, and September 2026, there is no specific evidence to confirm that two crocodiles were seen on October 8, 2026.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple local news reports confirm the presence of crocodiles in Kukkarahalli Lake over the past two years. However, none of the provided evidence specifically corroborates the claim that two crocodiles were spotted on the evening of October 8, 2026. The available sources only provide general context about crocodiles being in the lake, but do not confirm this particular sighting.
